summary: Frontend-only validation of the global timezone fix (UTC->BRT display) across 10 pages. Logged in as admin@mvno.com, then visited Dashboard, Logs, AtivacoesSelfService, Chips, Usuarios, AutomacaoBloqueio, Assinaturas, CarteiraMovel, PlanilhaOperacional. All pages loaded successfully with dates rendered in DD/MM/YYYY (date-only fields) and DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM (datetime fields) in America/Sao_Paulo timezone. No 'Invalid Date', no 'Erro ao carregar pagina' fallback, no React runtime errors. Login-timestamp evidence at time of test showed '15/08/2026, 23:30..23:32' on Dashboard/Logs matching BRT wall-clock (backend serves UTC without 'Z' and helpers correctly append UTC and convert to BRT).
critical_code_review_comments: dateFormat.js parseAsUTC treats naive datetime strings as UTC – this is correct given backend serialization behavior. If backend ever starts emitting local (BRT) strings without TZ, the helper would double-shift; consider centralizing serialization on the backend (always emit ISO with 'Z') to make the frontend rule bullet-proof.

formatters.js still duplicates formatDateTimeBR logic already present in dateFormat.js. Consider re-exporting from a single source-of-truth to avoid future drift (both were patched this session, so they're currently in sync).

Route naming inconsistency: paths are '/ativacoes-selfservice', '/carteira', '/operacional' – the review-request document referenced '/ativacoes-self-service', '/carteira-movel', '/planilha-operacional'. Not a bug, just a doc/routing mismatch worth aligning.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (10/10 routes rendered dates correctly with no errors)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Correct route paths in the app are: /operacional (PlanilhaOperacional), /carteira (CarteiraMovel), /ativacoes-selfservice (AtivacoesSelfService). The review request had slightly different paths – use the actual ones from App.js. All timezone-related dates verified in BRT.
rca of the issue: Original bug: backend datetime fields serialized without 'Z' suffix; the browser's Date() parses these as local time causing +/- day shift. Fix (verified): helpers in /app/frontend/src/lib/dateFormat.js and /app/frontend/src/lib/formatters.js detect missing TZ marker and append 'Z' before parsing, then format via toLocaleString with timeZone: 'America/Sao_Paulo'. Confirmed correct display across all requested pages.
